title: Weak Airflow or No Air Coming Out

nodes.text_en: Is any air coming out of the AC vents at all?
nodes.text_hi: Kya AC ke vents se bilkul bhi hawa nikal rahi hai?

options.label: No air at all / Completely dead vent
Air is coming out, but airflow is very weak

nodes.text_en: Can you hear the indoor fan motor humming or does it show error CH 10?
nodes.text_hi: Kya indoor fan motor ki humming sunai de rahi hai ya display par CH 10 aa raha hai?

nodes.text_en: Is the air filter heavily clogged with dust, or is there visible ice on the indoor coil fins?
nodes.text_hi: Kya filter dhool se jam gaya hai ya cooling fins par barf (ice) dikh rahi hai?

options.label: Filter is clean and no ice

nodes.text_en: Did cleaning the filter restore strong, normal airflow?
nodes.text_hi: Filter saaf karne se kya hawa ka pressure wapas normal ho gaya?

nodes.text_en: Is the fan speed set to High (F3/F5) or is the indoor blower wheel visibly caked with deep dirt?
nodes.text_hi: Kya fan speed High par hai aur kya blower wheel ke blades par moti dhool ki parat jami hai?

options.label: Blower wheel blades are heavily choked with dust
Clean blower wheel, but fan spins slowly on high setting

diag_evaporator_coil_frozen.probable_cause: Evaporator Coil Choked with Ice due to Low Gas or Blower Failure
diag_evaporator_coil_frozen.rag_query: LG AC ice on cooling coil weak airflow defrosting
diag_evaporator_coil_frozen.technician_note: Turn off cooling, melt ice. Check gas pressure and clean evaporator.

diag_blower_wheel_deep_clog.probable_cause: Indoor Blower Wheel Blades Choked with Dirt / Fungal Sludge
parts: High Pressure Water Jet Wash Service
diag_blower_wheel_deep_clog.rag_query: LG AC blower fan cleaning pressure jet service
diag_blower_wheel_deep_clog.technician_note: Dismantle indoor fascia, pressure wash cross-flow blower.

diag_blower_motor_capacitor_open.probable_cause: Indoor BLDC Blower Motor Failure / Blown Thermal Fuse
diag_blower_motor_capacitor_open.rag_query: LG AC indoor blower motor not spinning replacement
diag_blower_motor_capacitor_open.technician_note: Check motor winding continuity and 310V DC / 15V DC supply to motor.

diag_blower_motor_degraded.probable_cause: Fan Motor Run Capacitor Weak or Motor Hall Sensor Degraded
diag_blower_motor_degraded.rag_query: LG AC fan speed slow low airflow capacitor check
diag_blower_motor_degraded.technician_note: Measure motor RPM and capacitor rating.
